brief: 剧情向视觉小说 / interactive narrative visual novel — ethereal fantasy (唯美幻想) atmosphere, dusk-violet & gold, reading-first portrait UI.

pages.role: Title / key visual with start, continue, load, settings entries.
Dialogue scene — character sprite, bottom dialogue box, auto/skip/history/save quick entries.
Choice branch — situation description, branch buttons, affinity/route hints.
Save / load — multi save-slot list with thumbnail, time, chapter info.
Character / CG gallery codex with unlocked and locked states.
Settings — text speed, music/sfx/voice volume, auto interval, language, restore defaults.

styleAxes.mood: 唯美幻想 ethereal dusk — dreamy, immersive, calm and reading-friendly.
styleAxes.accent: warm starlight gold (#E8C77A) over deep dusk violet/indigo (#1A1330 / #261A45).
styleAxes.density: Generous spacing, large readable type (32-44px body), soft 18-32px radii, breathing cards.
styleAxes.typography: Bold luminous headings with light gold; soft lavender-white body text for long-form reading.
